correctness.rationale: Positive weighted-welfare characterization proves PO iff no crossed pair; first two A goods force agent 1 to hold A, thus all B must go to agent 1. EF1 at each A prefix pairs allocations, odd endpoint to agent 1 fails after first B, and exact agent-2 EF1 inequality at B-prefix length t is t beta <= alpha (1+p mod 2). The final prefix is strongest; counts 2^floor(p/2) are exhaustive and distinct. The accompanying exact exhaustive comparison of 192 cases over 45120 allocations and 189 independent structure cases supports the analytic proof.

This is motivated by designing temporally fair yet efficient allocation sequences, not an arbitrary small-instance computation. Restrictions and unproved extensions are explicit.
